name: Second Wind
overview: Rehab (rehabilitation center) is a place where, with the help of specialized specialists, they get rid of harmful habits. Desperate, the mother takes the Hero to a rehabilitation center. Instead of specialists, there are charlatans, their methods are punitive medicine and brainwashing. Here, all communication is considered toxic, friendship is not welcome, and the social rating can be raised by listening in and knocking on each other. The hero decides to leave this place by all means.
